caption: KalshiEX LLC v. Flaherty
citation_line: KalshiEX LLC v. Flaherty, No. 1:25-cv-02152; aff’d, No. 25-1922 (3d Cir. Apr. 6, 2026)
headnote_district_ruling: Judge Kiel preliminarily barred New Jersey gaming regulators from enforcing state gambling laws against sports-related event contracts offered on Kalshi’s CFTC-licensed designated contract market.
qualification_rationale: The case sits at the new boundary between federally regulated prediction markets and state sports-wagering regimes, with direct consequences for federalism, derivatives regulation and online betting.
appellate_posture_note: The Third Circuit affirmed in a precedential opinion, holding that Kalshi showed a reasonable likelihood that the Commodity Exchange Act’s exclusive-jurisdiction structure preempts otherwise applicable New Jersey gambling law.
